messages.subject: RE: pvcancer social media accounts
messages.body:
Hi Mike,

Following up on the social accounts.

We completely understand that the website has to go through the doctors
before it goes live, and we are not trying to push on that - sign-off on a
cancer practice's website should take the time it takes, and we would
rather it were reviewed properly than rushed.

The social accounts are a separate track though, and they do not depend on
that approval at all. Facebook, Instagram and the LinkedIn page already
exist, they are already yours, and nothing we post to them touches the
website that is under review. So we would like to get started on those now
rather than waiting.

The reason it matters: both accounts were being posted to regularly before
we came on board - Facebook every day or two, Instagram through the end of
August. Momentum on a page is much easier to keep than to rebuild, and
right now the gap is growing while we wait on access rather than on
anything to do with content. We already have the audit done and know the
themes that have been working.

WHAT WE NEED ACCESS TO
All three are accounts you already own - nothing new gets created.

  * Facebook Page - facebook.com/pvhomed
    Admin or Editor via Meta Business Suite. Settings > Page setup >
    People, or assign us as a Partner if the page sits inside a
    Business Manager account.

  * Instagram - @paloverdecancerspecialists
    Easiest route is linking it to the same Business Suite account
    as the Facebook page, then granting us access there. Otherwise
    E
